summary.name: ClawdHome
summary.one_liner: ClawdHome is a macOS multi-user manager for running and isolating multiple OpenClaw instances for you and your family, managed from one control panel.
use_cases: Run several isolated OpenClaw instances on one Mac
Share an AI workstation among family members
Monitor CPU, GPU, memory and disk usage of AI workloads
Install ClawdHome automatically via an AI agent using skill.md
Manage multiple OpenClaw gateways from one control panel
summary.what_it_does: ClawdHome is described as an all-in-one multi-user manager for macOS, designed to run and isolate OpenClaw instances for a user and their family. It provides a single control panel to manage multiple isolated OpenClaw gateway instances. It includes real-time monitoring of CPU, GPU, memory and disk usage. The page says it can be installed by sending an install instruction, pointing to clawdhome.app/skill.md, to an agent such as OpenClaw or Cursor. The page also mentions planned features such as smart home control, which are still in development.
notable: Isolated multi-user setup for OpenClaw instances on one Mac
Real-time CPU, GPU, memory and disk monitoring
Listed as open source on GitHub (ThinkInAIXYZ/clawdhome) in awesome-mac
caveats: Early access: the page says launch is within 1–2 weeks and access requires a beta seat registration with invite codes sent by email
Smart home integration and other features are still in active development
